question: What is the total number of Padma Awards given in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**139**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India** announced the **Padma Awards** for the **year 2025** on the eve of the **76th Republic Day**.
 
• For the **year 2025**, the **President of India** has approved the conferment of **139 Padma Awards**.
 
• The total count of **139** awards includes **5 Padma Vibhushan**, **17 Padma Bhushan**, and **117 Padma Shri** awards.
 
• Among the awardees, **33** are **women**, and the list includes **11** persons from the category of **Foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI** and **18 Posthumous** awardees.
